videos.title: Guy's Grocery Games
videos.description: Four previous winners return to take on more of Guy Fieri's festive games. In round one, the chefs must shop for ingredients using a stocking.

videos.title: Guy's Grocery Games
videos.description: Guy brings in four judges to compete using unusual ingredients. The winner will go on a Flavortown shopping spree worth up to $20,000.

videos.description: The Hairy Bikers create mouthwatering festive dishes and edible Christmas presents, getting into the spirit of the season with a variety of special guests.

videos.title: The Hairy Bikers Home For Christmas
videos.description: The Hairy Bikers create dishes to keep the party going on those limbo days between Christmas and New Year! They're joined by special guest, Alex Jones.

videos.description: The Hairy Bikers serve up feel-good meat-free dishes for a welcome break from all that meat! And, Paul Martin joins them for some festive cheer.

videos.description: The Hairy Bikers prepare delicious festive party food, from a trio of canapes to porchetta pork loin. They're joined by special guest, Denise Lewis.

videos.description: The Bikers add some winter sunshine to festivities with dishes such as turkey jambalaya and spicy lamb shank. Nicki Chapman joins them in the kitchen.

videos.title: Jamie Oliver: Together Christmas Dinner
videos.description: Jamie creates a stunning alternative to a traditional Christmas dinner with an epic mixed roast, a yummy veggie crown and a toffee panettone dessert.

videos.title: Jamie Oliver: Together Christmas Party
videos.description: Jamie starts festivities with a Christmas party menu of bramble cocktails, tasty beef bourguignon, and a sparkling winter bombe ice cream dessert.

videos.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking Christmas Special
videos.description: Nigel Slater reveals fantastic festive recipes, including a sumptuous casserole, that will warm cockles and fill hungry stomachs throughout the Christmas period.

videos.title: Guy's Big Bite
videos.description: Guy loves surprising people, especially at the holidays. He serves up a shockingly tasty pork rib eye, bacon-blessed Brussels sprouts, and a festive drink.

videos.title: Guy's Big Bite
videos.description: Guy Fieri brings fresh and festive flavours to his holiday table. Delicious dishes include roasted acorn squash soup, and spicy ginger snaps for dessert.

videos.title: Holiday Baking Championship
videos.description: The bakers turn steakhouse desserts into decadent holiday treats. Then, they must transform a classic icon into a tasty Christmas tree.

videos.title: Buddy Vs. Christmas
videos.description: Buddy Valastro competes against Lego artists Corey and Travis Samuels to build the most unique toy. The Lego team create a life-size action figure.

videos.title: Holiday Wars
videos.description: Raven-Symone challenges the four remaining teams of master cake and sugar artists to imagine the most-romantic wedding the world has ever seen at the North Pole.
